mapper.select: SELECT A.auction_id, A.judge_kind_name, A.title, A.description, A.weight, A.kind, A.grade, A.INITIAL_PRICE, A.BUY_NOW_PRICE, A.BID_INCREMENT, A.CURRENT_BID_PRICE, A.START_DATE, A.END_DATE, A.AUTO_EXTEND, A.traceability_num, U.USER_NAME, I.image_id, I.image_url, I.order_index FROM AUCTIONS A INNER JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES I ON A.auction_id = I.product_id INNER JOIN USERS U ON A.seller_id = U.id WHERE A.auction_id = #{auctionId}
SELECT AUCTION_ID FROM AUCTIONS WHERE END_DATE <= #{currentTime} AND AUCTION_STATUS = 'on'
